</TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>PART III &#8212; NARRATIVE </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">State below in reasonable detail the reasons why Forms <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">10-K,</FONT> <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">20-F,</FONT> <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">11-K,</FONT> <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">10-Q,</FONT> <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">10-D,</FONT> <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">N-SAR,</FONT> <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">N-CSR</FONT> or the transition report
or portion thereof, could not be filed within the prescribed period. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Karyopharm Therapeutics Inc. (the &#8220;Company&#8221;) has
determined that it is unable, without unreasonable effort or expense, to file its Quarterly Report on Form <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">10-Q</FONT> for the quarter ended September&nbsp;30, 2026 (the &#8220;Quarterly Report&#8221;) by the
prescribed filing date or the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">five-day</FONT> extension permitted by the rules of the Securities and Exchange Commission (the &#8220;SEC&#8221;). </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">As previously announced, on November&nbsp;2, 2026, the Company and its subsidiary KPT Texas LLC (together with the Company, the
&#8220;Debtors&#8221;) filed voluntary petitions (the &#8220;Bankruptcy Petitions&#8221;) under Chapter 11 of title 11 of the United States Code (the &#8220;Bankruptcy Code&#8221;) in the United States Bankruptcy Court for the Southern District of
Texas, Houston Division (such court, the &#8220;Court&#8221; and such cases, the &#8220;Cases&#8221;). The case number is <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">26-90827</FONT> (ARP) and the case is styled as <I>In re Karyopharm Therapeutics Inc., et al.
</I>Additional information regarding the Cases is available at: https://cases.stretto.com/KPTI. The documents and other information on this website are not part of this Form <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">12b-25</FONT> and are not incorporated by
reference. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">As previously announced, on November&nbsp;2, 2026, prior to the filing of the Bankruptcy Petitions, the Debtors entered into a
Restructuring Support Agreement (the &#8220;Restructuring Support Agreement&#8221;) with Ayrmid Ltd. (&#8220;Ayrmid&#8221;) and the other parties thereto, which provides for Ayrmid to serve as the stalking horse bidder for a merger between Ayrmid
and the reorganized Company, subject to higher or otherwise better bids. The Restructuring Support Agreement contemplates that the transactions will be implemented through the Debtors&#8217; Joint Prepackaged Chapter 11 Plan of Reorganization filed
on November&nbsp;2, 2026 (the &#8220;Prepackaged Plan&#8221;), under which the Company&#8217;s existing equity interests will be cancelled without any distribution. The Company expects the Ayrmid transaction to close in the first quarter of 2027,
subject to the conditions described in the Restructuring Support Agreement and the Prepackaged Plan. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The Company continues to operate its
business as a &#8220;debtor in possession&#8221; under the jurisdiction of the Court and in accordance with the applicable provisions of the Bankruptcy Code, orders of the Court, and applicable <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-bankruptcy</FONT>
law. In the period leading up to and following commencement of the Cases, the Company&#8217;s management team and other personnel have devoted significant time and attention to materials and workflows required in connection with the Cases and the
related transactions, including the marketing process for a sale of, or investment in, the Company, the Ayrmid transaction and the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">debtor-in-possession</FONT></FONT> facility
(collectively, the &#8220;Related Transactions&#8221;). Additionally, the Company has limited availability of finance and accounting personnel as part of the Company&#8217;s efforts to minimize operating expenses during the pendency of the
Cases.</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">On November&nbsp;11, 2026, the Nasdaq Stock Market (&#8220;Nasdaq&#8221;) suspended trading of the Company&#8217;s common stock.
Nasdaq will file a Form <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">25-NSE</FONT> with the SEC to remove the common stock from listing and registration on Nasdaq. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Due to the time and attention required by the Cases and the Related Transactions, the Company is unable to timely file its Form <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">10-Q</FONT> without unreasonable effort or expense and is unable to estimate when it will be able to complete and file the Form <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">10-Q.&nbsp;The</FONT> Company expects to file monthly
operating reports with the Court. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B><I>Cautionary Language Regarding Trading in the Company&#8217;s Common Stock </I></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The Company&#8217;s securityholders are cautioned that trading in the Company&#8217;s securities during the pendency of the Cases is highly
speculative and poses substantial risks. The Company&#8217;s common stock has been suspended from trading on, and the Company received a notice of delisting from, the Nasdaq Global Select Market and is currently trading on The Pink Limited Market
under the symbol &#8220;KPTIQ&#8221;. Trading prices for the Company&#8217;s securities may bear little or no relationship to the actual recovery, if any, by the Company&#8217;s securityholders in the Cases. The Prepackaged Plan provides that
holders of the Company&#8217;s common stock and the 0% Series A Convertible Perpetual Preferred Stock will not receive any payment or other distribution on account of such securities. Accordingly, the Company urges extreme caution with respect to
existing and future investments in its securities. In particular, the Company expects that its existing equity securities will have no value and that holders of such securities will experience a complete loss on their investment under the
Prepackaged Plan as currently proposed. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B><I>Cautionary Language Regarding Forward-Looking Statements </I></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">This Form <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">12b-25</FONT> contains certain forward-looking statements that reflect, when made, the
Company&#8217;s current views with respect to current events and financial performance. These forward-looking statements are within the meaning of The Private Securities Litigation Reform Act of 1995. These forward-looking statements include, but
are not limited to, statements regarding process and potential outcomes of the Cases, the timing of and the Company&#8217;s ability to consummate the transactions contemplated by the Restructuring Support Agreement and the Prepackaged Plan, the
expected treatment of the Company&#8217;s securities in the Cases, the Company&#8217;s ability to continue to operate as usual during the Cases, and/or statements preceded by, followed by or that include the words &#8220;anticipates,&#8221;
&#8220;believes,&#8221; &#8220;expects,&#8221; &#8220;intends,&#8221; &#8220;potential,&#8221; &#8220;projects,&#8221; &#8220;target,&#8221; &#8220;will,&#8221; &#8220;would,&#8221; and &#8220;future&#8221; or similar expressions. These statements
are based upon the current expectations and beliefs of management and are subject to certain risks and uncertainties that could cause actual results to differ materially from those described in these forward-looking statements. Except as otherwise
may be required by law, the Company undertakes no obligation to update or publicly release any revisions to forward-looking statements to reflect events, circumstances, or changes in expectations after the date of this Form <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">12b-25.</FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>PART IV &#8212; OTHER INFORMATION </B></P>

Company is unable to estimate the amount of these charges, including any such impairments. As such, the Company cannot estimate what significant changes would be reflected in its results of operations for the three and nine months ended
September&nbsp;30, 2026 as compared to the corresponding periods ended September&nbsp;30, 2025.</P> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt; margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
